text: Implemented first compressed LatentSketch execution backend. Added LatentSketchPrepared with a global orthonormal identity-response voxel assignment for the resolved selection; prepare fits latent responses once, and chunk execution decodes only local coefficient, residual variance, standard-error, and voxelwise covariance columns. Full-rank identity remains OLS-equivalent; fixed-component sketches now execute with finite inference and chunked Future execution matches unchunked output from the same prepared sketch. Evidence: sbt fitJVM/test passed 121; sbt modelJVM/test passed 16; sbt modelJS/test passed 16; sbt fitJS/test passed 116; final sbt fitJVM/test fitJS/test passed 121/116; scoped diff check clean; trailing-whitespace scan clean. Remaining: true latent/shared-basis backends, reduced-rank GLS covariance/inference bundles, and fmrireg lowrank/rrr fixture parity.
